summary: Magnachip Semiconductor entered into an At Market Issuance Sales Agreement with B. Riley Securities to sell up to $50M of common stock from time to time. This is an ordinary at-the-market (ATM) shelf takedown, not a transformative special situation. The filing reports a routine capital-markets financing arrangement for general corporate purposes. No change of control, acquisition, divestiture, or other special event is present. The filing is properly classified as a routine current report under Item 1.01.
